## Biography

Himel is a tenure-track Principal Investigator at [Cornell University's](https://weillcornell.org/) [Department of Population Health Sciences](https://phs.weill.cornell.edu/), with joint appointments in the [Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology](https://medicine.weill.cornell.edu/divisions-programs/gastroenterology-hepatology) and the [Department of Statistics and Data Science](https://stat.cornell.edu/) at [Bowers College of Computing and Information Science](http://cis.cornell.edu/).

His [group at Cornell](https://mallicklab.weill.cornell.edu) develops computational methods, software, and data products to generate and validate testable hypotheses that accelerate data-driven discovery. Much of his research has focused on reverse translational efforts aiming to integrate vastly different kinds of biological data by leveraging a combination of causal machine learning, systems biology, and omics data science techniques to enable target identification and biomarker discovery across a range of indications.

Himel is a [Fellow of the American Statistical Association (FASA)](https://www.amstat.org/your-career/awards/asa-fellows), an Elected Member of the [International Statistical Institute (ISI)](https://www.isi-web.org/), and the recipient of [several early-career and research awards](awards/index.qmd).
